title: Session
description: A unit of agent work that outlives any one harness. `harness` is an opaque identifier ADP never branches on — that is what makes the protocol harness-neutral. A session resumed under a different harness is a new session linked by `resumed_from_session_id`, never an edit to the old one. Per docs/pragmatic_mvp.md M3 and docs/m3-readiness-review.md M3-3.

harness.description: Free-form identifier of whatever is driving this session, e.g. 'claude-code' or 'openhands'. Never interpreted by ADP.

resumed_from_session_id.description: The session this one was resumed from. Walking this chain yields the full cross-harness lineage.
